To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the prevalence of overweight and obesity in adults in Botswana was high and that overweight and obesity were associated with older age, living in a large urban area, and having attained higher education.

overweight and obesity are more prevalent among women than among men, and that the main socio-demographic risk factors for being overweight and obese are being older, living a city/town and being married.
the prevalence of obesity is high in Botswana, especially among women.

the prevalence of overweight and obesity in a population in sub-Saharan Africa.
the relationship between social capital, gender and health in the developing world, specifically in the context of HIV/AIDS and the social determinants of health.
understanding the prevalence of, as well as socio-demographic factors that influence, overweight and obesity among men and women in Botswana.

the prevalence of obesity in Botswana is increasing and is higher among women than among men.
